title: Coffee mug
subject: Generic 82 x 95 mm mug holding 350 ml, not a specific product

designs.tradeoff: Holds less heat. Static lift only: chipping and drops are untested
Lightest, hot to hold, loses heat fastest

sense: Holes and lattices rejected, because a mug must hold liquid
Lifting is not the limit: about 1 MPa against a 20 to 30 MPa limit
Chipping and drops decide ceramic wall thickness, and this static test cannot check them
Heat retention is qualitative here, not simulated
Tipping angle stays near 31 degrees in a rough calculation, though a lighter mug slides more easily
line: For a robot we remove material. For a mug, physics says the walls were never the problem.
